method: Sort every named WGSERVER import slot by virtual address and recover contiguous 4-byte x86 IAT runs.
closed_boundaries: Every supplied MMUD/MMPLS WGSERVER import is represented by a 4-byte x86 IAT slot.
IAT slot order and virtual addresses are now canonicalized per exact module hash.
WCC/WBB counterparts can be validated without assuming interchangeable file identity.
limitations: IAT layout identifies linkage slots, not implementations inside WGSERVER.EXE.
The native type behind data imports remains unknown beyond the 32-bit imported slot value.
